deduplicate_crystal_structures: deduplicate a pandas DataFrame of crystal structures using hash-based pre-filtering and parallel crystallographic comparison
deduplicate_with_custom_tolerance: deduplicate crystal structures with custom lattice, site, and angle tolerance parameters for fine-grained similarity control
deduplicate_and_remove_duplicates: deduplicate crystal structures and remove duplicate entries keeping one representative per unique group
process_structure_group_clustering: process a pre-filtered group of crystal structures using greedy clustering with pymatgen StructureMatcher
review_deduplicate_structures: review the deduplicate_structures function to understand the two-stage hash-based pre-filtering and crystallographic comparison algorithm
